areas: The outer coast of Westport County from Cape Hollis to Harbor Point
fields.evaluation: A strong earthquake occurred near the coast at 0622 AM PST. Based on the earthquake location and magnitude a destructive tsunami is possible for coasts near the source.
fields.quake: Magnitude 7.9 (preliminary), 0622 AM PST, 46.8 N 124.4 W, depth 20 km
fields.actions: Move inland to high ground or out of the tsunami hazard zone now. Do not wait for official confirmation. Stay away from the coast until local officials say it is safe.
fields.nextUpdate: The next message will be issued within 30 minutes or sooner if conditions warrant.
